# LiltKey

> LiltKey is a local, offline streaming voice typing tool for Linux and Fcitx5. Hold Ctrl+Alt to speak and release to finish; text appears at the cursor as you talk, with Chinese–English mixed dictation and automatic punctuation. Recognition runs on the local CPU and audio is never uploaded.
>
> LiltKey 是一款为 Linux Fcitx5 打造的本地离线语音输入法。按住 Ctrl+Alt 说话，松开结束，边说边在光标处输入，支持中英混合听写和停顿自动加标点。识别在本机 CPU 上完成，不上传录音。

- Product name: LiltKey. The package, command and config directory are named `fcitx5-voice` (config: `~/.config/fcitx5-voice/config.toml`).
- Current version: 0.5.0, distributed as a `.deb` for Ubuntu 26.04 (amd64), requires Fcitx5 5.1.19 or newer.
- License: original code is MIT; dependencies and pretrained models keep their own licenses.
- Runs on sherpa-onnx: a bilingual Chinese–English Streaming Zipformer model for default streaming recognition, a CT-Transformer model for punctuation, and SenseVoiceSmall for optional final correction or offline preview. Streaming refinement is off by default and requires an extra model. About 260 MiB of models are downloaded on first setup, after which dictation works offline.
- Ships a light Fcitx5 theme enabled on first setup; existing custom themes, dark preferences and fonts are preserved.
- The interface (status messages, notifications, setup prompts) and the detailed docs are currently in Chinese only; the README is available in English. Dictation works in both Chinese and English.
- Existing pinyin input keeps working. Voice input is disabled in password and sensitive fields.
- Not provided: noise suppression, personal hotwords, cloud recognition, automatic rewriting. Accuracy has not yet been validated on a real-user dictation dataset.

## Docs

- [Landing page](https://tangzk.github.io/liltkey/): features, usage guide, installation and FAQ
- [Landing page (Chinese)](https://tangzk.github.io/liltkey/zh/): the same content in Chinese
- [README](https://github.com/tangzk/liltkey/blob/main/README.md): installation and shortcuts ([Chinese](https://github.com/tangzk/liltkey/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md))
- [Advanced usage](https://github.com/tangzk/liltkey/blob/main/docs/advanced-usage.md): microphone, recognition modes, troubleshooting, upgrade and uninstall
- [Development guide](https://github.com/tangzk/liltkey/blob/main/docs/development.md): build from source, build the deb, tests
- [Theme](https://github.com/tangzk/liltkey/blob/main/themes/README.md): default theme, switching and restoring appearance
- [Validation notes](https://github.com/tangzk/liltkey/blob/main/docs/validation.md): test results and known limitations

- [Model comparison](https://tangzk.github.io/liltkey/#research): six models on 60 public FLEURS clips, measured on a local CPU; full-clip compute times are not key-release latency.
